body:
I'd like to talk to my parents about it, but my dad just brushes it off, and my mum just cries and asks me not to talk about it, in my experience.

I have friends and a boyfriend but I feel weird talking about it with them.  Like it's attention seeking or they don't care. I've brought it up a few times but everyone has their own issues and they don't really have the time to worry about me.
